description: This file defines functions related to handling calendar events, including expanding recurring events within a date range and scheduling reminders via an external notification client. It imports models and clients, and provides a public interface for expanding events and scheduling notifications.

classes.name: EventModel
classes.description: Data model representing a calendar event, including fields like start_time, end_time, recurrence rules, and reminders.

methods.name: List[EventModel] expand_event_recurrence(event: EventModel, range_start: datetime, range_end: datetime)
methods.description: Expands a recurring event into individual event instances within a specified date range, handling daily and weekly frequencies.

methods.name: schedule_event_reminders(event: EventModel, notification_client: NotificationClient)
methods.description: Schedules reminder notifications for an event by calculating reminder times and invoking an external notification client.
